```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = "hide")

input_file <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
has_input_file <- !is.null(input_file) &&
  length(input_file) > 0 &&
  !is.na(input_file) &&
  nzchar(input_file)

if (has_input_file) {
  input_dir <- dirname(normalizePath(input_file, mustWork = FALSE))
  project_dir <- if (basename(input_dir) == "code") {
    normalizePath(file.path(input_dir, ".."), mustWork = TRUE)
  } else {
    normalizePath(input_dir, mustWork = TRUE)
  }
} else {
  cwd <- normalizePath(getwd(), mustWork = TRUE)
  project_dir <- if (basename(cwd) == "code") {
    normalizePath(file.path(cwd, ".."), mustWork = TRUE)
  } else {
    cwd
  }
}

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_dir)
setwd(project_dir)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tximport)
  library(DESeq2)
  library(WGCNA)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(Mfuzz)
  library(Biobase)
  library(scales)
  library(igraph)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(jsonlite)
})


options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
WGCNA::allowWGCNAThreads()

rdata_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "RData")
dir.create(rdata_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

rds_file <- function(name) {
  file.path(rdata_dir, paste0(name, ".rds"))
}

cache_or_run <- function(name, expr, refresh = FALSE) {
  path <- rds_file(name)
  if (file.exists(path) && !refresh) {
    message("Loading cached object: ", path)
    readRDS(path)
  } else {
    message("Running and saving object: ", path)
    value <- force(expr)
    saveRDS(value, path)
    value
  }
}

load_rds_object <- function(name, required = TRUE) {
  path <- rds_file(name)
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    if (required) stop("Missing cached object: ", path)
    return(NULL)
  }
  readRDS(path)
}

load_rds_list <- function(name, required = TRUE, envir = .GlobalEnv) {
  value <- load_rds_object(name, required = required)
  if (!is.null(value)) list2env(value, envir = envir)
  invisible(value)
}

analysis_file <- function(...) {
  file.path(rdata_dir, ...)
}

input_file_path <- function(...) {
  cached <- file.path(rdata_dir, ...)
  if (file.exists(cached)) return(cached)
  file.path(project_dir, ...)
}

show_table <- function(x, n = 20, title = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(title)) {
    cat("\n### ", title, "\n\n", sep = "")
  }
  if (is.null(x)) {
    cat("No object available.\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  df <- as.data.frame(x)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    cat("No rows.\n")
    return(invisible(df))
  }
  print(utils::head(df, n))
  invisible(df)
}

show_plot_files <- function(paths) {
  paths <- paths[file.exists(paths)]
  if (length(paths) == 0) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  paths <- normalizePath(paths, mustWork = TRUE)
  knitr::include_graphics(paths)
}
```

```{r}
############################################################
## Step 5. NLR-centered co-expression network analysis
##
## Purpose:
##   Build NLR-centered co-expression networks from prioritized WGCNA modules.
##   This is NOT a causal regulatory network.
##   It is a co-expression candidate network centered on DE TNL/CNL/RNL genes.
##
## Main inputs:
##   1. WGCNA_TCR_NLR_module_enrichment/WGCNA_module_TCR_NLR_enrichment.tsv
##   2. gene_module_df OR moduleColors + wgcna_data
##   3. wgcna_data OR expr_matrix
##   4. log2FC_threshold_sensitivity_TNL_CNL_RNL/NLR_TCR_LRT_Wald_log2FC_sensitivity.tsv
##
## Main outputs:
##   NLR_centered_coexpression_network/
##     Cytoscape_NLR_centered_edges.tsv
##     Cytoscape_NLR_centered_nodes.tsv
##     NLR_seed_hub_ranking.tsv
##     Module_network_summary.tsv
##     per_module_networks/
##     figures
############################################################


options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
WGCNA::allowWGCNAThreads()


## -----------------------------
## 0. Settings
## -----------------------------

outdir <- analysis_file("NLR_centered_coexpression_network")
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

module_outdir <- file.path(outdir, "per_module_networks")
dir.create(module_outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

fig_outdir <- file.path(outdir, "figures")
dir.create(fig_outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

tcr_levels <- c("TNL", "CNL", "RNL")

min_abs_cor <- 0.80
max_pvalue <- 0.05
top_n_targets_per_NLR <- 50

top_n_network_modules <- 8

min_DE_TCR_NLR_for_network <- 2

include_previous_focus_modules <- FALSE
previous_focus_modules <- c("red", "blue", "turquoise")

manual_modules_to_include <- c("red")

soft_power_for_weight <- if (exists("softPower")) {
  softPower
} else if (exists("power")) {
  power
} else {
  4
}

cat("Using soft power for approximate edge weight:", soft_power_for_weight, "\n")

type_cols <- c(
  TNL = "#7B3294",
  CNL = "#008837",
  RNL = "#E66101"
)

node_class_cols <- c(
  Seed_DE_NLR = "#B2182B",
  Other_TCR_NLR = "#EF8A62",
  Coexpressed_gene = "#9E9E9E"
)

save_plot <- function(plot_obj, filename, width = 7, height = 5) {
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(fig_outdir, paste0(filename, ".pdf")),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height
  )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(fig_outdir, paste0(filename, ".png")),
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = 300
  )
}

as_logical_safe <- function(x) {
  if (is.logical(x)) return(x)
  
  x_chr <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  
  dplyr::case_when(
    x_chr %in% c("TRUE", "T", "1", "YES", "Y") ~ TRUE,
    x_chr %in% c("FALSE", "F", "0", "NO", "N") ~ FALSE,
    TRUE ~ NA
  )
}

safe_name <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    str_replace_all("[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]+", "_")
}

empty_edges_tbl <- function() {
  tibble(
    Source = character(),
    Target = character(),
    Module = character(),
    Correlation = numeric(),
    abs_cor = numeric(),
    pvalue = numeric(),
    padj_BH = numeric(),
    Direction = character(),
    EdgeType = character(),
    SourceType = character(),
    TargetType = character(),
    SourceIsSeedNLR = logical(),
    TargetIsNLR = logical(),
    AdjacencyApprox = numeric(),
    SourceModule = character(),
    TargetModule = character()
  )
}


## -----------------------------
## 1. Read WGCNA module enrichment result
## -----------------------------

module_enrichment_file <- analysis_file("WGCNA_TCR_NLR_module_enrichment", "WGCNA_module_TCR_NLR_enrichment.tsv")

if (!file.exists(module_enrichment_file)) {
  stop(
    "Cannot find WGCNA module enrichment file: ",
    module_enrichment_file,
    "\nPlease run the WGCNA module re-ranking step first."
  )
}

module_enrichment <- read_tsv(
  module_enrichment_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    Module = as.character(Module)
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    FDR_DE_TCR,
    desc(FoldEnrichment_DE_TCR),
    desc(DE_TCR_density),
    desc(DE_TCR_NLR),
    ModuleSize
  )

cat("\n===== Top enriched WGCNA modules =====\n")
print(
  module_enrichment %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Rank_DE_TCR_enrichment,
      Module,
      ModuleSize,
      DE_TCR_NLR,
      DE_TCR_density,
      FoldEnrichment_DE_TCR,
      p_over_DE_TCR,
      FDR_DE_TCR,
      Priority
    ) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 20)
)


## -----------------------------
## 2. Prepare gene_module_df
## -----------------------------

if (!exists("gene_module_df")) {
  
  if (exists("moduleColors") && exists("wgcna_data")) {
    
    gene_module_df <- tibble(
      Gene = colnames(wgcna_data),
      Module = as.character(moduleColors)
    )
    
    message("gene_module_df was created from moduleColors and colnames(wgcna_data).")
    
  } else {
    
    stop(
      "Cannot find gene_module_df. Please provide gene_module_df with columns Gene and Module, ",
      "or provide moduleColors + wgcna_data."
    )
  }
}

gene_module_df_clean <- as.data.frame(gene_module_df) %>%
  as_tibble()

if (!"Gene" %in% colnames(gene_module_df_clean)) {
  colnames(gene_module_df_clean)[1] <- "Gene"
}

if (!"Module" %in% colnames(gene_module_df_clean)) {
  
  possible_module_cols <- c(
    "module", "ModuleColor", "moduleColor",
    "colors", "moduleColors"
  )
  
  matched_module_col <- intersect(possible_module_cols, colnames(gene_module_df_clean))
  
  if (length(matched_module_col) >= 1) {
    gene_module_df_clean <- gene_module_df_clean %>%
      dplyr::rename(Module = all_of(matched_module_col[1]))
  } else {
    colnames(gene_module_df_clean)[2] <- "Module"
  }
}

gene_module_df_clean <- gene_module_df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    Gene = as.character(Gene) %>% str_trim(),
    Module = as.character(Module) %>% str_trim()
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Gene), Gene != "", !is.na(Module), Module != "") %>%
  distinct(Gene, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, Module)

cat("\n===== gene_module_df check =====\n")
cat("WGCNA genes:", nrow(gene_module_df_clean), "\n")
cat("WGCNA modules:", n_distinct(gene_module_df_clean$Module), "\n")


## -----------------------------
## 3. Prepare expression matrix as datExpr
##    Required orientation: samples × genes
## -----------------------------

if (exists("wgcna_data")) {
  
  datExpr_raw <- wgcna_data
  message("Using object 'wgcna_data' as expression input.")
  
} else if (exists("datExpr")) {
  
  datExpr_raw <- datExpr
  message("Using object 'datExpr' as expression input.")
  
} else if (exists("expr_matrix")) {
  
  datExpr_raw <- expr_matrix
  message("Using object 'expr_matrix' as expression input.")
  
} else {
  
  stop(
    "Cannot find expression data. Please provide one of: wgcna_data, datExpr, or expr_matrix."
  )
}

datExpr_raw <- as.data.frame(datExpr_raw)

gene_overlap_cols <- sum(colnames(datExpr_raw) %in% gene_module_df_clean$Gene)
gene_overlap_rows <- sum(rownames(datExpr_raw) %in% gene_module_df_clean$Gene)

cat("\nGene overlap with expression matrix:\n")
cat("Overlap with columns:", gene_overlap_cols, "\n")
cat("Overlap with rows:", gene_overlap_rows, "\n")

if (gene_overlap_rows > gene_overlap_cols) {
  datExpr <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(datExpr_raw)))
  message("Expression matrix was transposed to samples × genes.")
} else {
  datExpr <- datExpr_raw
  message("Expression matrix is treated as samples × genes.")
}

common_expr_genes <- intersect(colnames(datExpr), gene_module_df_clean$Gene)

if (length(common_expr_genes) == 0) {
  stop("No overlapping genes between expression matrix columns and WGCNA gene_module_df.")
}

datExpr <- datExpr[, common_expr_genes, drop = FALSE]

datExpr <- as.data.frame(datExpr)
datExpr[] <- lapply(datExpr, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))

keep_gene_cols <- sapply(datExpr, function(x) {
  sum(!is.na(x)) >= 3 && sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
})

datExpr <- datExpr[, keep_gene_cols, drop = FALSE]

cat("\n===== datExpr check =====\n")
cat("Samples:", nrow(datExpr), "\n")
cat("Genes:", ncol(datExpr), "\n")


## -----------------------------
## 4. Read TNL/CNL/RNL master table
## -----------------------------

candidate_master_files <- c(
  analysis_file("log2FC_threshold_sensitivity_TNL_CNL_RNL", "NLR_TCR_LRT_Wald_log2FC_sensitivity.tsv"),
  "NLR_TCR_LRT_Wald_log2FC_sensitivity.tsv",
  analysis_file("NLR_master_TNL_CNL_RNL.tsv")
)

existing_master_files <- candidate_master_files[file.exists(candidate_master_files)]

if (length(existing_master_files) >= 1) {
  
  nlr_master_file <- existing_master_files[1]
  
  nlr_master <- read_tsv(
    nlr_master_file,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
  
  message("Using NLR master file: ", nlr_master_file)
  
} else if (exists("nlr_master")) {
  
  nlr_master <- as.data.frame(nlr_master) %>%
    as_tibble()
  
  message("Using object 'nlr_master' from current R environment.")
  
} else {
  
  stop(
    "Cannot find NLR master table. Please provide one of:\n",
    paste(candidate_master_files, collapse = "\n")
  )
}

if (!"Gene" %in% colnames(nlr_master)) {
  colnames(nlr_master)[1] <- "Gene"
}

if (!"Type" %in% colnames(nlr_master)) {
  stop("NLR master table must contain a column named Type.")
}

nlr_master <- nlr_master %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    Gene = as.character(Gene) %>% str_trim(),
    Type = as.character(Type) %>% str_trim() %>% str_to_upper()
  ) %>%
  filter(Type %in% tcr_levels) %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of("Module")) %>%
  left_join(gene_module_df_clean, by = "Gene") %>%
  mutate(
    Type = factor(Type, levels = tcr_levels)
  )

if ("DE_LRT" %in% colnames(nlr_master)) {
  nlr_master <- nlr_master %>%
    mutate(DE_LRT = as_logical_safe(DE_LRT))
} else if ("padj" %in% colnames(nlr_master)) {
  nlr_master <- nlr_master %>%
    mutate(
      DE_LRT = case_when(
        !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05 ~ TRUE,
        !is.na(padj) & padj >= 0.05 ~ FALSE,
        TRUE ~ NA
      )
    )
} else {
  stop("NLR master table must contain either DE_LRT or padj.")
}

cat("\n===== TNL/CNL/RNL NLR check =====\n")
print(
  nlr_master %>%
    group_by(Type) %>%
    summarise(
      Total_NLR = n(),
      In_WGCNA = sum(!is.na(Module)),
      In_expression = sum(Gene %in% colnames(datExpr)),
      DE_LRT = sum(DE_LRT == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
      DE_LRT_in_expression = sum(DE_LRT == TRUE & Gene %in% colnames(datExpr), na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
)


## -----------------------------
## 5. Choose modules for network analysis
## -----------------------------

auto_modules <- module_enrichment %>%
  filter(DE_TCR_NLR >= min_DE_TCR_NLR_for_network) %>%
  arrange(
    FDR_DE_TCR,
    desc(FoldEnrichment_DE_TCR),
    desc(DE_TCR_density),
    desc(DE_TCR_NLR),
    ModuleSize
  ) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = top_n_network_modules) %>%
  pull(Module)

modules_to_network <- unique(c(manual_modules_to_include, auto_modules))

if (include_previous_focus_modules) {
  modules_to_network <- unique(c(modules_to_network, previous_focus_modules))
}

modules_to_network <- modules_to_network[
  modules_to_network %in% gene_module_df_clean$Module
]

if (length(modules_to_network) == 0) {
  stop("No modules were selected for network analysis.")
}

write_lines(
  modules_to_network,
  file.path(outdir, "Modules_selected_for_NLR_centered_network.txt")
)

cat("\n===== Modules selected for NLR-centered network =====\n")
print(
  module_enrichment %>%
    filter(Module %in% modules_to_network) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Rank_DE_TCR_enrichment,
      Module,
      ModuleSize,
      DE_TCR_NLR,
      DE_TCR_density,
      FoldEnrichment_DE_TCR,
      FDR_DE_TCR,
      Priority
    ) %>%
    arrange(match(Module, modules_to_network))
)


## -----------------------------
## 6. Optional functional annotation
## -----------------------------

anno_df <- NULL

if (exists("anno")) {
  
  anno_df <- as.data.frame(anno) %>%
    as_tibble()
  
  if (!"Gene" %in% colnames(anno_df)) {
    colnames(anno_df)[1] <- "Gene"
  }
  
  anno_df <- anno_df %>%
    mutate(Gene = as.character(Gene) %>% str_trim()) %>%
    distinct(Gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  message("Using object 'anno' for node annotation.")
  
} else {
  
  candidate_anno_files <- c(
    "annotation.tsv",
    "annotations.tsv",
    "eggnog_annotation.tsv",
    "eggnog_annotations.tsv",
    "eggnog.emapper.annotations"
  )
  
  existing_anno_files <- candidate_anno_files[file.exists(candidate_anno_files)]
  
  if (length(existing_anno_files) >= 1) {
    
    anno_file <- existing_anno_files[1]
    
    anno_df <- read_tsv(
      anno_file,
      comment = "#",
      show_col_types = FALSE
    )
    
    if (!"Gene" %in% colnames(anno_df)) {
      colnames(anno_df)[1] <- "Gene"
    }
    
    anno_df <- anno_df %>%
      mutate(Gene = as.character(Gene) %>% str_trim()) %>%
      distinct(Gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
    
    message("Using annotation file: ", anno_file)
  }
}

if (!is.null(anno_df)) {
  
  anno_keep_cols <- c(
    "Gene",
    "Preferred_name",
    "Description",
    "KEGG_Pathway",
    "KEGG_ko",
    "GOs",
    "PFAMs",
    "COG_category"
  )
  
  anno_df <- anno_df %>%
    dplyr::select(any_of(anno_keep_cols))
  
} else {
  message("No annotation table found. Node annotation will only contain network and NLR metadata.")
}


## -----------------------------
## 7. Function: calculate module eigengene and kME
## -----------------------------

calculate_module_kME <- function(mod, genes_in_module) {
  
  genes_in_module <- intersect(genes_in_module, colnames(datExpr))
  
  if (length(genes_in_module) == 0) {
    return(tibble())
  }
  
  mat <- datExpr[, genes_in_module, drop = FALSE]
  
  keep <- sapply(mat, function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
  mat <- mat[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  
  if (ncol(mat) == 0) {
    return(tibble())
  }
  
  if (ncol(mat) == 1) {
    
    ME <- as.numeric(scale(mat[, 1]))
    names(ME) <- rownames(mat)
    
  } else {
    
    mat_scaled <- scale(mat)
    mat_scaled[is.na(mat_scaled)] <- 0
    
    pc <- prcomp(
      mat_scaled,
      center = FALSE,
      scale. = FALSE
    )
    
    ME <- pc$x[, 1]
  }
  
  kME <- sapply(
    colnames(mat),
    function(g) {
      suppressWarnings(
        cor(
          datExpr[, g],
          ME,
          use = "pairwise.complete.obs",
          method = "pearson"
        )
      )
    }
  )
  
  tibble(
    Gene = names(kME),
    Module = mod,
    kME = as.numeric(kME),
    abs_kME = abs(as.numeric(kME))
  )
}


## -----------------------------
## 8. Function: build NLR-centered network for one module
## -----------------------------

build_nlr_centered_network <- function(mod) {
  
  cat("\nBuilding network for module:", mod, "\n")
  
  mod_genes <- gene_module_df_clean %>%
    filter(Module == mod) %>%
    pull(Gene) %>%
    unique()
  
  mod_genes <- intersect(mod_genes, colnames(datExpr))
  
  if (length(mod_genes) < 2) {
    message("Module ", mod, " has fewer than 2 expressed genes. Skipped.")
    return(empty_edges_tbl())
  }
  
  seed_nlrs <- nlr_master %>%
    filter(
      Module == mod,
      DE_LRT == TRUE,
      Type %in% tcr_levels,
      Gene %in% mod_genes
    ) %>%
    pull(Gene) %>%
    unique()
  
  if (length(seed_nlrs) == 0) {
    message("Module ", mod, " has no expressed DE TNL/CNL/RNL seed genes. Skipped.")
    return(empty_edges_tbl())
  }
  
  cat("Module genes:", length(mod_genes), "\n")
  cat("Seed DE TCR NLRs:", length(seed_nlrs), "\n")
  
  seed_mat <- datExpr[, seed_nlrs, drop = FALSE]
  target_mat <- datExpr[, mod_genes, drop = FALSE]
  
  cor_mat <- tryCatch(
    {
      WGCNA::bicor(
        seed_mat,
        target_mat,
        use = "pairwise.complete.obs",
        maxPOutliers = 0.1
      )
    },
    error = function(e) {
      message("bicor failed for module ", mod, ". Using Pearson correlation instead.")
      cor(
        seed_mat,
        target_mat,
        use = "pairwise.complete.obs",
        method = "pearson"
      )
    }
  )
  
  cor_mat <- as.matrix(cor_mat)
  
  if (is.null(rownames(cor_mat))) {
    rownames(cor_mat) <- seed_nlrs
  }
  
  if (is.null(colnames(cor_mat))) {
    colnames(cor_mat) <- mod_genes
  }
  
  p_mat <- WGCNA::corPvalueStudent(
    cor_mat,
    nSamples = nrow(datExpr)
  )
  
## Build edge table from the correlation matrix
## 
edges_raw <- expand.grid(
  Source = rownames(cor_mat),
  Target = colnames(cor_mat),
  KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    Source = as.character(Source),
    Target = as.character(Target),
    Correlation = as.numeric(as.vector(cor_mat)),
    pvalue = as.numeric(as.vector(p_mat)),
    Module = as.character(mod),
    abs_cor = abs(Correlation)
  ) %>%
  filter(Source != Target)
  
  if (nrow(edges_raw) == 0) {
    return(empty_edges_tbl())
  }
  
  edges_filtered <- edges_raw %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(Correlation),
      !is.na(pvalue),
      abs_cor >= min_abs_cor,
      pvalue <= max_pvalue
    ) %>%
    group_by(Source) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs_cor), pvalue, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = top_n_targets_per_NLR) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      padj_BH = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "BH"),
      Direction = if_else(Correlation >= 0, "positive", "negative"),
      SourceIsSeedNLR = TRUE,
      TargetIsNLR = Target %in% nlr_master$Gene,
      AdjacencyApprox = abs_cor ^ soft_power_for_weight,
      SourceModule = mod,
      TargetModule = mod
    )
  
  if (nrow(edges_filtered) == 0) {
    message(
      "No edges passed thresholds in module ",
      mod,
      ". Consider lowering min_abs_cor from ",
      min_abs_cor,
      " to 0.75."
    )
    return(empty_edges_tbl())
  }
  
  type_lookup <- nlr_master %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene, Type) %>%
    distinct(Gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  source_type <- type_lookup$Type[match(edges_filtered$Source, type_lookup$Gene)]
  target_type <- type_lookup$Type[match(edges_filtered$Target, type_lookup$Gene)]
  
  edges_filtered <- edges_filtered %>%
    mutate(
      SourceType = as.character(source_type),
      TargetType = as.character(target_type),
      TargetType = replace_na(TargetType, "non_NLR"),
      EdgeType = case_when(
        TargetIsNLR ~ "NLR_to_NLR",
        TRUE ~ "NLR_to_coexpressed_gene"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Source,
      Target,
      Module,
      Correlation,
      abs_cor,
      pvalue,
      padj_BH,
      Direction,
      EdgeType,
      SourceType,
      TargetType,
      SourceIsSeedNLR,
      TargetIsNLR,
      AdjacencyApprox,
      SourceModule,
      TargetModule
    ) %>%
    arrange(Module, Source, desc(abs_cor))
  
  return(edges_filtered)
}


## -----------------------------
## 9. Build networks for selected modules
## -----------------------------

network_edges <- purrr::map_dfr(
  modules_to_network,
  build_nlr_centered_network
)

if (nrow(network_edges) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No network edges were generated. ",
    "Try lowering min_abs_cor to 0.75 or increasing top_n_targets_per_NLR."
  )
}

write_tsv(
  network_edges,
  file.path(outdir, "Cytoscape_NLR_centered_edges.tsv")
)

cat("\n===== Network edges generated =====\n")
cat("Total edges:", nrow(network_edges), "\n")
## 10. Build node table
## -----------------------------

network_genes <- unique(c(network_edges$Source, network_edges$Target))
seed_genes <- unique(network_edges$Source)

nlr_node_anno <- nlr_master %>%
  dplyr::select(
    any_of(c(
      "Gene",
      "Type",
      "RawClass",
      "baseMean",
      "stat",
      "pvalue",
      "padj",
      "DE_LRT",
      "Cluster",
      "max_abs_log2FC",
      "log2FC_at_max",
      "main_response_time",
      "direction_at_max",
      "response_strength",
      "Wald_sig_timepoints"
    ))
  ) %>%
  distinct(Gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

nodes <- tibble(Gene = network_genes) %>%
  left_join(gene_module_df_clean, by = "Gene") %>%
  left_join(nlr_node_anno, by = "Gene") %>%
  mutate(
    IsSeedNLR = Gene %in% seed_genes,
    IsTCR_NLR = Gene %in% nlr_master$Gene,
    IsDE_TCR_NLR = Gene %in% nlr_master$Gene[nlr_master$DE_LRT == TRUE],
    Type = as.character(Type),
    Type = replace_na(Type, "non_NLR"),
    NodeClass = case_when(
      IsSeedNLR ~ "Seed_DE_NLR",
      IsTCR_NLR ~ "Other_TCR_NLR",
      TRUE ~ "Coexpressed_gene"
    )
  )

## -----------------------------
## Degree and weighted degree
## -----------------------------

degree_source <- network_edges %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Source_tmp = as.character(.data[["Source"]])) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Source_tmp) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    OutDegree = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Gene = Source_tmp)

degree_target <- network_edges %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Target_tmp = as.character(.data[["Target"]])) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Target_tmp) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    InDegree = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Gene = Target_tmp)

weighted_degree <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  network_edges %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Gene = as.character(.data[["Source"]]),
      weight = as.numeric(.data[["abs_cor"]])
    ),
  network_edges %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Gene = as.character(.data[["Target"]]),
      weight = as.numeric(.data[["abs_cor"]])
    )
) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Gene) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    WeightedDegree = sum(weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    MeanAbsCor = mean(weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    MaxAbsCor = max(weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\n===== degree table check =====\n")
print(head(degree_source))
print(head(degree_target))
print(head(weighted_degree))


nodes <- nodes %>%
  left_join(degree_source, by = "Gene") %>%
  left_join(degree_target, by = "Gene") %>%
  left_join(weighted_degree, by = "Gene") %>%
  mutate(
    OutDegree = replace_na(OutDegree, 0L),
    InDegree = replace_na(InDegree, 0L),
    Degree = OutDegree + InDegree,
    WeightedDegree = replace_na(WeightedDegree, 0),
    MeanAbsCor = replace_na(MeanAbsCor, 0),
    MaxAbsCor = replace_na(MaxAbsCor, 0)
  )

# kME for network genes
kME_df <- purrr::map_dfr(
  unique(nodes$Module),
  function(mod) {
    if (is.na(mod)) return(tibble())
    genes_mod <- nodes %>%
      filter(Module == mod) %>%
      pull(Gene)
    calculate_module_kME(mod, genes_mod)
  }
)

nodes <- nodes %>%
  left_join(kME_df, by = c("Gene", "Module"))

# optional functional annotation
if (!is.null(anno_df)) {
  nodes <- nodes %>%
    left_join(anno_df, by = "Gene")
}

nodes <- nodes %>%
  arrange(
    factor(NodeClass, levels = c("Seed_DE_NLR", "Other_TCR_NLR", "Coexpressed_gene")),
    Module,
    desc(Degree),
    Gene
  )

write_tsv(
  nodes,
  file.path(outdir, "Cytoscape_NLR_centered_nodes.tsv")
)


## -----------------------------
## 11. Export per-module edge and node tables
## -----------------------------

for (mod in unique(network_edges$Module)) {
  
  mod_safe <- safe_name(mod)
  
  mod_edges <- network_edges %>%
    filter(Module == mod)
  
  mod_nodes <- nodes %>%
    filter(Gene %in% unique(c(mod_edges$Source, mod_edges$Target)))
  
  write_tsv(
    mod_edges,
    file.path(module_outdir, paste0("Module_", mod_safe, "_edges.tsv"))
  )
  
  write_tsv(
    mod_nodes,
    file.path(module_outdir, paste0("Module_", mod_safe, "_nodes.tsv"))
  )
}


## -----------------------------
## 12. NLR seed hub ranking
## -----------------------------

nlr_seed_hub_ranking <- nodes %>%
  filter(IsSeedNLR) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(Degree),
    desc(WeightedDegree),
    desc(abs_kME),
    desc(max_abs_log2FC)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    HubRank = row_number()
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    HubRank,
    Gene,
    Type,
    Module,
    Degree,
    OutDegree,
    InDegree,
    WeightedDegree,
    MeanAbsCor,
    MaxAbsCor,
    kME,
    abs_kME,
    Cluster,
    padj,
    max_abs_log2FC,
    log2FC_at_max,
    main_response_time,
    direction_at_max,
    response_strength,
    everything()
  )

write_tsv(
  nlr_seed_hub_ranking,
  file.path(outdir, "NLR_seed_hub_ranking.tsv")
)

cat("\n===== Top NLR seed hubs =====\n")
print(
  nlr_seed_hub_ranking %>%
    dplyr::select(
      HubRank,
      Gene,
      Type,
      Module,
      Degree,
      WeightedDegree,
      abs_kME,
      max_abs_log2FC,
      main_response_time,
      direction_at_max
    ) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 20)
)


## -----------------------------
## 13. Top coexpressed targets for each NLR
## -----------------------------

top_targets_by_NLR <- network_edges %>%
  group_by(Source) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_cor), pvalue, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 20) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(
    nodes %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Gene,
        TargetNodeClass = NodeClass,
        TargetType = Type,
        TargetDegree = Degree,
        Target_kME = kME,
        any_of(c("Preferred_name", "Description", "KEGG_Pathway", "GOs"))
      ),
    by = c("Target" = "Gene")
  ) %>%
  arrange(Module, Source, desc(abs_cor))

write_tsv(
  top_targets_by_NLR,
  file.path(outdir, "Top_coexpressed_targets_by_NLR.tsv")
)


## -----------------------------
## 14. Module-level network summary
## -----------------------------

module_network_summary <- network_edges %>%
  group_by(Module) %>%
  summarise(
    Edges = n(),
    Positive_edges = sum(Direction == "positive"),
    Negative_edges = sum(Direction == "negative"),
    Seed_NLRs = n_distinct(Source),
    Target_genes = n_distinct(Target),
    Total_nodes = n_distinct(c(Source, Target)),
    NLR_targets = sum(TargetIsNLR),
    Mean_abs_cor = mean(abs_cor, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_abs_cor = median(abs_cor, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max_abs_cor = max(abs_cor, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    module_enrichment %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Module,
        Rank_DE_TCR_enrichment,
        ModuleSize,
        DE_TCR_NLR,
        DE_TCR_density,
        FoldEnrichment_DE_TCR,
        FDR_DE_TCR,
        Priority
      ),
    by = "Module"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Rank_DE_TCR_enrichment,
    desc(Edges)
  )

write_tsv(
  module_network_summary,
  file.path(outdir, "Module_network_summary.tsv")
)

cat("\n===== Module network summary =====\n")
print(module_network_summary)


## -----------------------------
## 15. Optional: candidate non-NLR hub targets
## -----------------------------

candidate_nonNLR_hubs <- nodes %>%
  filter(NodeClass == "Coexpressed_gene") %>%
  arrange(desc(Degree), desc(WeightedDegree), desc(abs_kME)) %>%
  mutate(TargetHubRank = row_number()) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    TargetHubRank,
    Gene,
    Module,
    Degree,
    InDegree,
    WeightedDegree,
    MeanAbsCor,
    MaxAbsCor,
    kME,
    abs_kME,
    any_of(c("Preferred_name", "Description", "KEGG_Pathway", "GOs"))
  )

write_tsv(
  candidate_nonNLR_hubs,
  file.path(outdir, "Candidate_nonNLR_coexpressed_hub_targets.tsv")
)

cat("\n===== Top coexpressed non-NLR hub targets =====\n")
print(
  candidate_nonNLR_hubs %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 20)
)

node_class_summary <- nodes %>%
  filter(Module %in% unique(network_edges$Module)) %>%
  dplyr::count(Module, NodeClass, name = "Node_count") %>%
  group_by(Module) %>%
  mutate(
    Module_total_nodes = sum(Node_count),

  ) %>%

p4 <- node_class_summary %>%

    Module = factor(Module, levels = module_network_summary$Module),

    ),

heatmap_df <- network_edges %>%
```
